name: open-haggsfield
description: Pre-release AI film editing studio with Comfy MiniMax workflows, alternate takes, private cloud checkpoints and non-destructive editing.

paragraphs: Turn AI generations into a film you can actually edit.

An independent React/Vite/Express studio with MiniMax H3 through Comfy Cloud. Generate alternate takes from text or a reference frame, compare them, replace a selected section and retain originals and undo history.

Pre-release: real MiniMax generation, private delivery, comparison, replacement, undo, private cloud save/restore and browser movie export have been exercised with an isolated test account. Demonstration: Customer generation remains gated while paid billing is completed. A MiniMax success does not verify the separate Higgsfield Seedance/Cinema integrations.
features: Scene/shot organization, searchable bins, alternate takes and multitrack editing.
Trims, split, ripple edits, partial replacement, framing, sound levels and undo/redo.
Encrypted account-owned provider keys, cost quotes, durable request tokens and conservative recovery of uncertain submission outcomes.
Comfy MiniMax H3 family text/image workflows with authenticated private video delivery and automatic return as a take.
Supabase private media and revisioned manual checkpoints; restore downloads sources into a separate local project.

whatItDoes.text: Turn AI generations into a film you can actually edit.

requirements.text: Creating/importing projects and editing local browser-compatible media do not require a provider account.
Create a studio account and retain its recovery code.
Configure your own Stripe sandbox API key, webhook secret and monthly price IDs using .env.example.
